rule.domain: complete integer Cartesian queue box from zero through the coordinatewise maxima of the frozen 5,003-state roster
rule.budget_curve: one continuous frozen legacy-v4 search per queue with every integer checkpoint K10 through K120; an exact endpoint is carried forward
rule.independent_oracle: enumerate all 100 ordered two-lane raw actions for maximum support; global tied raw action is diagnostic because equality pruning only certifies support optimality
rule.certified_coefficient: alpha_D(K)=max over nonempty D of returned (upper-score)/L1(queue)
rule.diagnostic_coefficients: actual oracle regret and frontier slack require the exhaustive oracle and are not deployable selector outputs
rule.generic_residual_margin: capacity effective_slack_eta minus alpha_D(K); this is a conservative finite-box approximate-oracle bridge
rule.seed_specific_baseline: the existing homogeneous-seed all-state eta and backlog threshold apply unchanged to every K>=10 and are not added to the generic bridge

advance_gate.next_stage: analytic all-queue or polyhedral-cone extension only

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more frozen execution checks fail
decision_rule.FINITE_BOX_MARGIN_VACUOUS_STOP: no K below 120 leaves positive generic residual margin at all loads
decision_rule.POSITIVE_MARGIN_WITHOUT_COMPUTE_SAVING_S: a subexact all-load positive margin exists but paid work is not below K120
decision_rule.POSITIVE_FINITE_BOX_MARGIN_ADVANCE_TO_GL: the first subexact all-load positive-margin K uses less paid work than K120

protocol.prohibited: arrivals, trajectory or drain simulation, RNG, server data, FIFO or other action-changing selectors, post-outcome budget changes, confirmation runs, and paper edits

next_step: derive an all-queue or polyhedral-cone alpha envelope; do not run trajectories

claim_boundary.supports: a computable K-to-approximate-oracle coefficient and residual-margin mapping on the complete registered-coordinate finite box
claim_boundary.does_not_support: global stability, positive recurrence, a Poisson-invariant finite state space, or improvement of the existing homogeneous-seed certificate
claim_boundary.seed_specific_certificate: the K-independent all-state homogeneous-seed certificate remains the stronger stability result for this model

limitations: The finite box is induced by reused development queues and is not an independent holdout.
Poisson arrivals can leave the finite box, so its alpha coefficient cannot be extended outside the box without another proof.
Actual regret and frontier slack diagnostics use the exhaustive oracle; only the returned gap is deployable.
K120 support exactness does not certify the globally earliest tied raw action because equality prefixes may be pruned.
